title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Entry Stamp direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Entry Stamp
options.lineage: passport and visa booklet entry stamps
options.thesis: Every check lands as a dated entry on an off-white record page, carried inside a navy booklet shell.
options.viewport: Navy shell with an off-white data page: rail nav, evidence rows each carrying a dated stamp, risk band set at display scale.
options.risk: Reads bureaucratic, and passport-holding is not universal among the students this serves; over-rotated stamps tip into novelty.

raised.raise: Hierarchy is carried by scale alone: the band number at display size against 11px tracked mono labels.
The focused evidence row expands in place to reveal source, excerpt and checked_at; neighbours hold still.
Every analysis carries a visible case reference reused across history, reports and appeals.

options.label: Dated Stamp
options.lineage: Indian government letterhead and dated rubber stamp
options.thesis: An official file: double rule lines, a centred masthead, and a vermillion dated stamp landing on every checked claim.
options.viewport: Paper-white file page under a double-ruled masthead; each evidence row is headed by a vermillion stamp carrying date and source.
options.risk: The most familiar answer in this category: verification products reach for the stamp constantly.

options.label: Utility Mosaic
options.thesis: A bright white mosaic of hairline-ruled modules, each wearing a small red label tab, packed edge to edge.
options.viewport: Dashboard as a dense module mosaic where every check is a ruled block with its own label tab.
options.case: Holds product clarity: the density courage this evidence load needs, and hairline modules keep status colour quarantined. Loses audience identification: the idiom is Tokyo retail, not an Indian job seeker's world.
options.risk: Reads as a shop front when the tabs outnumber the content.

options.label: Shoulder & Plate
options.thesis: A fixed-measure column with a thumb-index shoulder, and every colour in the system quarantined inside a bordered plate.
options.viewport: Evidence read at a 66-character measure with a shoulder index; status colour appears only inside bordered plates.
options.case: Holds product clarity: quarantined state colour and guide-word wayfinding solve this product's two hardest reading problems. Loses audience identification: a Victorian dictionary is not the audience's daily object.
options.risk: Reads as a book about the product rather than the product if the measure is obeyed everywhere.

options.label: Coupon Wallet
options.thesis: Each step is a carbon-copy coupon: states stamp themselves, and nothing ever disappears, it cancels.
options.viewport: The check flow as a coupon book, one leg per sheet, with the wallet always showing what remains.
options.case: Holds product clarity: 'nothing disappears, it cancels' is this product's status philosophy, and coupons map onto the multi-step check. Loses audience identification narrowly: boarding passes are known, the airline idiom is not theirs.
options.risk: Reads nostalgic-travel if the tear-off is played for charm.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Near-white paper, ink black, one accent, and hierarchy carried by scale contrast alone.
options.viewport: The band number at enormous display size against tiny monospace labels on a strict measure.
options.case: Loses both axes: a type foundry's specimen means nothing to this audience, and its generous negative space fights the density this evidence load needs.

options.label: Title Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles where the focused one expands and everything else quietly gets out of the way.
options.viewport: Checks as rows of tiles, the focused check lifting to reveal its metadata.
options.case: Loses both axes: an entertainment wall hides metadata behind focus, the opposite of evidence-first scanning, and its world is not this audience's.
options.kept: The focused item reveals its metadata in place.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Matte black, white hairline plot, hue blocks standing in for words, everything a numbered catalog entry.
options.viewport: Every check a catalog entry addressed by its reference number.
options.case: Loses both axes: 'state speaks in code' contradicts plain-language explanation, and matte black with hue blocks is the generic dark look this product refuses.
options.kept: Every artifact carries a stable reference number.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
